items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: to me there's a white boy that is an unsung hero to me as far as playing rhythm guitar is concerned... He's Sam Herman.

ctx.x: As big as he was, he could play so delicate and just everything in the right place.

Yes, and to me there's a white boy that is an unsung hero to me as far as playing rhythm guitar is concerned that people don't even talk about him, because he doesn't really play anymore anyway. He's got a copying service now. He's Sam Herman.
